qualifier: receptor tyrosine kinase cargo and lysosomal sorting
name: Ubiquitin-dependent RTK endocytosis and lysosomal sorting
rationale: All members concern ubiquitin-driven internalisation of receptors (EGFR, Met via InlB) and their MVB sorting for degradation, unlike confusables centred on ESCRT machinery, viral budding and exosomes.

qualifier: sinoatrial pacemaking and gap-junction coupling
name: Sinoatrial pacemaking and gap-junction cardiac conduction
rationale: Members regulate electrical conduction in the heart; HCN channels and SA node action potentials plus gap-junction coupling separate it from AV-node/ventricular depolarisation and conduction-system development confusables.

qualifier: type II cotransporters and their disorders
name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransporters and their disorders
rationale: All members concern type II Na+/Pi cotransporter function, regulation and its hereditary diseases, distinct from bicarbonate/anion exchangers and other phosphate transporter or mineralisation confusables.

qualifier: collateral sprouting
name: Axon collateral sprouting and regeneration
rationale: Members regulate collateral sprouting and regeneration of axons, versus confusables about netrin/semaphorin axon guidance and growth-inhibitory signalling.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, catabolism and intermembrane transfer
name: Glycerophospholipid synthesis, turnover and intermembrane transfer
rationale: Members cover synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG and cardiolipin, lysophospholipid hydrolysis and phospholipid transfer, whereas confusables emphasise acyl-chain remodelling, sphingolipids or glycolipid transport.

qualifier: PML bodies and oncogene-induced senescence
name: Nucleocytoplasmic protein shuttling, PML bodies and oncogene-induced senescence
rationale: Members regulate protein import/export and chromatin/DNA binding alongside PML body organisation, arsenite response and SAHF/senescence, unlike confusables about nuclear pores, SUMOylation machinery or p53.

qualifier: amino sugar synthesis and lysosomal glycan and glycosphingolipid catabolism
name: Amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal glycoconjugate metabolism
rationale: Members span amino sugar/sialic acid and N-glycan precursor metabolism plus glycosphingolipid and lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism with their disorders, unlike confusables about O-glycans, GPI synthesis or nucleotide-sugar transport.

qualifier: male copulation and parturition contraction
name: Male mating, insemination and parturition
rationale: Members concern male mating behaviour, erection and insemination together with uterine contraction in parturition, distinct from confusables on female mating, parental, aggressive and sleep behaviours.

qualifier: galactose, fructose and non-oxidative pentose phosphate with inborn errors
name: Galactose, fructose and pentose metabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members cover Leloir galactose, fructose, xylulose-5-phosphate/glucuronate, non-oxidative pentose phosphate and alditol metabolism with their enzyme deficiencies, unlike glycolysis/glycogen or dietary disaccharide confusables.

qualifier: promotion of differentiation, fusion and regeneration
name: Promotion of skeletal myoblast differentiation, fusion and regeneration
rationale: All members promote myoblast commitment, differentiation, fusion and satellite-cell regeneration, whereas confusables carry myoblast proliferation, migration and negative regulation.

core: Amino acid and peptide transmembrane transport
qualifier: neutral amino acids and proton-coupled oligopeptides
name: Neutral amino acid and proton-coupled oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members are plasma membrane transport of neutral/aromatic amino acids, histidine and di/oligopeptides by proton cotransporters, unlike confusables about cationic amino acids, polyamines or transporter disease variants.

qualifier: topoisomerase-DNA crosslinks and replication stress
name: Protein-DNA crosslink repair and replication-stress drug response
rationale: Members concern repair of covalent protein-DNA adducts and responses to camptothecin and hydroxyurea, distinct from confusables on double-strand break repair, Fanconi crosslink repair and DNA topology.

qualifier: glycosylation, degradation and antitumor T cell response
name: PD-L1 stability control and antitumor T cell responses
rationale: Members cover PD-L1 glycosylation, trafficking and proteasomal/lysosomal degradation plus regulation of T cell responses to tumours, unlike confusables on neddylation, proteasome or viral receptor downregulation.

qualifier: mRNA turnover and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial mRNA turnover and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial mRNA stability, decay and modification, rRNA modification and mitoribosome assembly, unlike confusables on mitochondrial tRNA processing, pseudouridylation or mtDNA transcription and replication.

qualifier: ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback
name: ERK1/2 signal termination by dephosphorylation and feedback
rationale: Members concern dephosphorylation and negative feedback inactivating ERK MAPK signalling and serine phosphorylation control, unlike confusables on ERK5, AP-1, JNK/p38 or IL-6 signalling.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid presentation
name: MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover exogenous peptide loading onto MHC class II, CD1 lipid presentation and its regulation in DCs/B cells, unlike confusables on MHC class I, cross-presentation, proteasome or NKT cells.

qualifier: heme scavenging and transport
name: Iron homeostasis with heme scavenging and transport
rationale: Members concern iron sensing and import plus heme scavenging, transport and assimilation, unlike confusables on heme biosynthesis, transferrin cycling or other metal ions.

qualifier: Rab GTPase regulation and prenylation
name: Rab GTPase regulation and Golgi structural organization
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly, disassembly and positioning together with Rab GEFs/GAPs, geranylgeranylation and vesicle tethering, unlike confusables on COPI/COPII coat-mediated vesicle traffic and endosomal transport.

qualifier: calcitonin- and glucagon-family receptors via cAMP
name: Calcitonin-family and glucagon-type peptide receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are peptide-hormone GPCRs (calcitonin/amylin/CGRP, glucagon-type, somatostatin) and adenylate cyclase/cAMP signalling, unlike confusables about insulin secretion, nutrient and fatty acid receptors.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and membrane transport for beta-oxidation
name: Fatty acid and carnitine membrane transport for beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern carnitine and fatty acid transport across membranes including transporter disorders and promotion of beta-oxidation, unlike confusables on beta-oxidation steps, ketone bodies or insulin secretion.

qualifier: PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinase control
name: Mitotic entry kinase signaling and centrosome separation
rationale: Members concern PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinase regulation at G2/M with centrosome separation and spindle formation, unlike confusables on spindle checkpoint, centrosome protein recruitment and cytokinesis.

qualifier: growth plate and joint morphogenesis
name: Chondrocyte differentiation, growth plate and joint development
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and joint/articular cartilage formation, unlike confusables about osteoblasts, direct ossification and tendon.

qualifier: mucosal agglutination, lysis and metal sequestration
name: Mucosal antibacterial defense by agglutination, lysis and sequestration
rationale: Members concern host defence against bacteria via agglutination, cytolysis, peptidoglycan targeting and metal sequestration at mucosa, unlike confusables centred on defensins, antifungal or neutrophil killing.

qualifier: multiciliogenesis, axoneme assembly and CSF flow
name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly, multiciliogenesis and CSF flow
rationale: Members cover motile cilia/axoneme and dynein arm assembly, multiciliated cell differentiation, mucociliary clearance and ventricular CSF circulation, unlike confusables on sperm motility, left-right asymmetry or tubulin modification.

qualifier: sialic acid and glycosylation precursors
name: Amino sugar, sialic acid and glycosylation precursor metabolism
rationale: Members synthesise UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid, dolichyl-phosphate-glucose and related hexosamine/mannose precursors with their disorders, unlike confusables on N-glycan processing, lysosomal catabolism or nucleotide-sugar transport.
